summary: The v63 hostile Wizard of Yendor reaches the clone-wizard spell. C mcastu.c:mcast_clone_wiz calls wizard.c:clonewiz when this is the sole Wizard; clonewiz creates a hostile awake Wizard at the hero’s square. JavaScript mcastu.js records MCAST_CLONE_WIZ as an unported gap and creates no clone. C’s makemon placement then reaches teleport.c:collect_coords; the first RNG and screen mismatch at step 834 reflects the missing clone path, not a defect in collect_coords.

source.branch: mcastu.c:mcast_clone_wiz checks iswiz and no_of_wizards == 1, prints “Double Trouble...” and calls clonewiz(); otherwise it invokes impossible(). wizard.c:clonewiz calls makemon(PM_WIZARD_OF_YENDOR, u.ux, u.uy, MM_NOWAIT), then makes a created clone hostile, awake, and untame; when the hero lacks the Amulet it conditionally gives a fake Amulet with rn2(2), applies the wizard appearance when shape changes are unprotected, and redraws it.
callers: mcastu.c:mcast_spell() dispatches MCAST_CLONE_WIZ to mcast_clone_wiz(); js/mcastu.js:mcast_spell() has the matching switch arm but records mcastu.c mcast_clone_wiz as an unported gap.
mcastu.c:mcast_clone_wiz() calls wizard.c:clonewiz(); js/mcastu.js currently has no production call to a clonewiz implementation.
dependencies: wizard.c:clonewiz() requires makemon.c:makemon() to create and place the duplicate. C currently owns a ready v57 throne-court delivery that reserves makemon.c:makemon; wait for acceptance and merge before claiming or relying on that implementation as a settled dependency.

The C placement path from makemon at the hero square reaches teleport.c:collect_coords through the existing enexto/placement helpers. The queue labels collect_coords at step 834 because C’s first additional placement shuffle uses rn2(8); JavaScript uses rn2(12) after it has skipped the MCAST_CLONE_WIZ gap.

evidence: The saved v63 admission evaluation at 3fc2021644e79e564fb762bc2038139c3241ff42 reports 834/1213 screens, 1032/1213 cursors, and 3164/106397 RNG calls before the first mismatch at step 834; the manifest and recording digests match the selected queue entry.

Replaying the saved C recording through the current JavaScript worktree reproduces the first screen mismatch at segment 0 step 834: C displays the duplicate Wizard (D) where JavaScript has a blank tile. The first RNG mismatch is C rn2(8)=1 from collect_coords(teleport.c:700) versus JS rn2(12)=1; all prior screens match.

nethack-c/upstream/src/mcastu.c:411-419 shows mcast_clone_wiz dispatching the sole Wizard to clonewiz. nethack-c/upstream/src/wizard.c:517-532 shows the clone creation, hostile state, fake-Amulet branch, appearance branch, and newsym.

js/mcastu.js:1112-1114 records the MCAST_CLONE_WIZ switch arm as an unported gap, so the clone and its inventory/placement path never run in JavaScript. teleport.c:1840-1893 shows the coordinate collection and shuffle used for monster placement; that is a downstream symptom of the missing clone.
